description.value: Route 14 is a family-friendly restaurant and pub established in 2016 in the heart of downtown Sooke, BC, winner of the 2024 Business Excellence Award for Dining from the Sooke Region Chamber of Commerce. The menu focuses on locally sourced ingredients — premium steaks, house-made burgers, Kennebec fries, organic herbs, and Ocean Wise seafood — complemented by a full bar with handcrafted cocktails and local beers. Positioned near the Juan de Fuca Trail, Sombrio Beach, and Whiffin Spit, it serves as a natural refueling stop for cyclists touring the southwest Vancouver Island corridor.
